name: 01420 · Fitchburg, MA
findings: ZIP 01420 (Fitchburg) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01420 (Fitchburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01420 (Fitchburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
